title: Before Your Family's Day Begins, Cover Them in Prayer 🙏 | Morning Prayer for Your Family
description:
Pray over your family this morning with KJV Scripture: every person by name, peace in your home, and one act of love for today.

Subscribe and pray with us every morning and every night.

Chapters
0:00 Opening prayer
13:00 Declaration for today
13:56 One thing to do today
14:26 Blessing

Narration and music: original HeroVerse productions.
